terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && ACCOUNTS_PROVIDER=json npm run dev
terminals.description: Product API — Fastify REST + WebSocket + Grok on http://localhost:3001 (JSON accounts, stub chat when XAI_API_KEY unset).

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd frontend && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm run dev
terminals.description: Product web — Next.js gallery/chat/Studio/account on http://localhost:3000.

terminals.name: webrtc
terminals.command: source .venv/bin/activate && VIDEO_PROVIDER=mock LLM_PROVIDER=mock python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: Optional WebRTC signaling + trainer studio (FastAPI, mock providers) on http://localhost:8000.
